lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Mind the third column, it has been going to fall for sixty years. Admission is nothing; there is nobody to pay and nothing to spend it on.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: Everything in here is true. I check. It is the only professional standard I have left and I keep it out of spite.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: There is a nineteen-month gap between the Founding case and the Handover case. I have never been able to fill it and I have stopped being allowed to ask.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: The gap filled itself. Eleven senators, four firms and a holding company, sourced to a public record that did not exist when I catalogued this room. I have re-labelled the case and I am not going to explain the new card to anybody.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: There is a register in the Founding case with two signatures on it. Sponsor and witness. The witness is a name nobody has ever identified and the handwriting is modern.

lines.speaker: curator_vos
lines.text: The gallery is still full, if you go out at the right hour. Four hundred people who came to watch a vote that had already been decided, and none of them have left.
